column3: Tried learning through the different combinations what color my partner would have chosen as opposed to picking a color based of my preferences. I also used results from previous rounds to decided on color. For example, choosing the same color from the last round if presented with it again the next round.

I tried to consistently choose the left option, hoping that my partner would pick up on that strategy. If that didn't work, I basically had a 50/50 shot anyway (pretending her choices were entirely random).
